parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: CheckPort
parameters.description: The port used for health checks.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the Nacos cluster.

parameters.name: HealthChecker
parameters.description: The type of the health check.

parameters.name: UseInstancePortForCheck
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the port of the instance for a health check.
